text:
maya: quick note — canary eval for model redwood/v2-quant failed gating this morning, blocking the rollout.
sahil: :eyes: which metric tripped the gate?
maya: rerank_accuracy dropped from 0.842 -> 0.777 on canary. rouge-l micro also down ~3.2 pts on open-domain benchmark.
alice: CI showed eval/gate:metrics-threshold failing. logs attached in console link: https://console.redwood.dev/evals/runs/9876
kelly: did we change metric definitions recently? I remember a bump for rerank to use negative-log loss normalization.
ben: there was an import tweak in eval-metrics (commit 1f4a3c7) that adjusted score normalization for small-label datasets.
maya: started a quick bisect locally:
```
git bisect start HEAD v2-quant-stable
git bisect run ./tools/eval/run_regression.sh --suite rerank-open
```
eval-runner-bot: bisect found candidate commit 1f4a3c7 — metric normalization change. Repro: rerank_accuracy drops locally.
sahil: ok copy. Does the PR mention metric definition change? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval/commit/1f4a3c7
alice: PR shows a change from "scale=labels.sum()" -> "scale=labels.sum()+eps" to avoid div-by-zero. That could shift scores for tiny label counts.
kelly: interesting — should be safe but maybe effect on micro-avg. We need to know if this is a code bug or expected behavior change.
maya: regression gating policy: failing gate = release blocked. Suggest revert the commit for canary roll.
ben: opened revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval/pull/312 — includes unit test that captures previous behavior.
sahil: what's the risk of reverting? any downstream correctness issues?
alice: low risk short-term; but we'll add a follow-up patch to handle tiny-label normalization explicitly and add test coverage.
maya: can we unfreeze canary now after revert?
eval-runner-bot: revert PR merged, CI green for eval/gate:* — canary redeployed at 11:24 UTC
maya: redeploy succeeded, metrics back to baseline (rerank_accuracy 0.840 -> 0.843). :tada: 
kelly: add a dashboard card showing label-count distribution per dataset, so small-label cases are visible going forward.
ben: filed infra ticket INF-441 to add the card + alert.
alice: leaving notes in the release issue and marking this as "gating-fix" in the changelog.
maya: thanks all. will follow up with a proper metric-definition RFC to avoid surprise regressions. :white_check_mark:
